nodes.text: Sit if you like. I don't get up for anyone any more and I've stopped apologizing for it.

Ferried. Not the old man's boat - a smaller one, upriver, before the water got opinions.

I knew every reed bank between here and the Tollman's crossing. They are all still there. I am simply no longer the shape that gets into a boat.

Two things. Mend your boots before they need it, and do not fight anything you have not watched for a minute first.

The second one is worth more. Everything out there has a rhythm and most people die inside the first four seconds of not knowing it.
